'''Muhammad Ali''' is a Pakistani academic and biologist. He is a recipient of the [[Sitara-e-Imtiaz]] and [[Tamgha-e-Imtiaz]]. He is a professor at the [[Centre of Excellence in Molecular Biology]] (CEMB) at the [[University of the Punjab]], Lahore (UPL).<ref name=":1" />

== Early life ==
Ali received an MSc from the [[University of the Punjab]], Lahore. He obtained a PhD in Biological Sciences from the [[University of Wales]], in 1999, and later completed postdoctoral research at the [[University of Missouri]].{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}}

== Career ==
Ali began his academic career as a lecturer at [[Lawrence College Ghora Gali|Lawrence College]], Murree. He held academic and administrative positions at several universities in Pakistan. He served as vice chancellor of multiple universities, including [[Quaid-i-Azam University]], [[Government College University Faisalabad]], [[Bahauddin Zakariya University]] , Multan, and the UPL.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ali Profile – Bahauddin Zakariya University, Multan (Pakistan) |url=https://bzu.edu.pk/view_faculty.php?facultyID=415&deptID=46 |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Bzu.edu.pk}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ali Profile |url=https://profiles.gcuf.edu.pk/profile/profdrmali |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240315201704/https://profiles.gcuf.edu.pk/profile/profdrmali |archive-date=2024-03-15 |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Profiles.gcuf.edu.pk |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ali Joins the Quaid-i-Azam University as Vice Chancellor – QAU |url=https://qau.edu.pk/prof-dr-muhammad-ali-joins-the-quaid-i-azam-university-as-vice-chancellor/ |access-date=2026-06-06 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-09-24 |title=Punjab appoints VCs of seven public sector universities |url=https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1233290-punjab-appoints-vcs-of-seven-public-sector-universities |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=The News International |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Pakistan Academy of Sciences {{!}} Members of the Academy |url=https://www.paspk.org/members-of-the-academy/ |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Paspk.org}}</ref>

At UPL he served as Vice Chancellor and as a professor associated with the CEMB ([[Centre of Excellence in Molecular Biology]]) where he also served as Chairman of the Board of Governors.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Prof Dr Muhammad Ali – Centre of Excellence in Molecular Biology |url=https://www.cemb.edu.pk/?page_id=17386 |access-date=2026-06-06 |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Research ==
Ali's research interests include [[molecular biology]], [[genetics]] and [[fisheries]]. He authored research publications on molecular biology and genetics.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2">{{cite web|url=https://pu.edu.pk/images/cv/1310362613582.pdf|format=PDF|title=Muhammad Ali CV|website=Pu.edu.pk|access-date=2026-10-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Journals |url=https://www.azsp.org/journals |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Azsp.org |language=en}}</ref>

Ali published more than 1,140 research articles and received more than 12,000 citations.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof Dr Muhammad Ali |url=https://scholar.google.com.pk/citations?user=UG-34WsAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Scholar.google.com.pk}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
* [[Sitara-e-Imtiaz]]<ref name=":3" />
* [[Tamgha-e-Imtiaz]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kZrsjqXLFKw |title=Prof. Dr. Muhammad Ali receiving Tamgha-e-Imtiaz from Governor Punjab |date=2017-08-22 |last=Government College University Faisalabad |access-date=2026-06-06 |via=YouTube}}</ref> 
* Pakistan Academy of Sciences Gold Medal 
* Best University Teacher{{Citation needed|date=July 2026}}

== Professional service ==
Ali is associated with the [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]]. He served on academic and administrative bodies, including university syndicates, senates and academic boards. He chaired the Punjab Accreditation Committee.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=PU Syndicate approves Rs 20.16b budget – Scholarships for students, research grant increased |url=http://pu.edu.pk/ |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Pu.edu.pk |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=PU Senate approves Rs. 170 million scholarships for students |url=http://pu.edu.pk/ |access-date=2026-06-06 |website=Pu.edu.pk |language=en}}</ref>
